source_caveats: Publisher cleaned duplicate timestamps and appliance-column assignments.
Missing IAM values were filled, and spikes above 4000 W were replaced with zero; imputation is not separately identified for every value.
Issues=1 flags summed submeter readings above the aggregate; it is not a complete missingness flag.
Sensor readings were polled asynchronously at approximately 6-8 seconds; not exact synchronized 8-second measurements.
Household labels and some appliances changed during monitoring; use the official per-home documentation.
scope: Dataset obtained; acquisition alone does not complete external validation.
